headline: Snapchat tops 30 million paid subscribers across its plans
summary: Snap says Snapchat has surpassed 30 million paid subscribers across Snapchat+ and other plans. TechCrunch links the milestone to a controversial change a year ago requiring payment for extra Memories storage, while Engadget credits demand for AI-powered effects among power users.
